name: Sense-Dulling Hood (Lesser)
text:
Activate 1 (manipulate)

---
Sometimes, an enemy's dangerous special ability makes relatively standard sensory capabilities a liability. From an ofalth emitting its stench to a banshee wailing, plenty of creatures use their prey's senses against them. A sense-dulling hood is a wide, single-use mask designed to be pulled from an airtight package and slipped over the head. The mask grants you a +2 item bonus to saving throws against auditory, olfactory, and visual effects for 10 minutes. Since it dulls your senses without depriving you of them, the mask also imposes a –1 penalty to rolls and checks using Perception for the same duration.

Effect: Sense-Dulling Hood (Lesser)
